name: Find Your Reason
concept: A genuine local search of the six supplied reasons makes the Command density idea useful without inventing product results or hiding any content.
silhouette: sticky editorial heading beside a dark search canopy and six permanently visible white index rows
focal_reason: Command density, demonstrated only inside this section study
interaction: Typing highlights matching rows without filtering; slash focuses search, Escape clears it, Enter focuses the first match. A live status describes results; without JavaScript all six remain visible.
safety: The search reads only this page, not the live Hub; results are the supplied reasons, never fabricated product data. Both illustrative claims remain qualified beside their text.
